prix.q: Do I have to pay to start?
prix.a: No. You get a 14-day Standard trial, or 30 days with a valid referral code, without a bank card. You then choose a paid plan to continue taking bookings. Signing up does not authorise an automatic charge.

miseEnLigne.q: Is my page online straight away?
miseEnLigne.a: Your web address is reserved the moment you sign up, but the page goes public once our team has checked it. You can prepare your catalogue and opening hours in the meantime.

seule.q: What if I work on my own?
seule.a: That is the most common case. Simply create your own provider profile: your hours and your appointments attach to it.

paiement.q: How do my clients pay me?
paiement.a: Clients pay you using the methods you offer at your salon. The platform tracks deposits and their supporting documents. Your subscription payment is a separate process; KKIAPAY may be offered depending on your country and the active configuration.

donnees.q: Can I get my data back?
donnees.a: Yes, at any time. Your client list and your appointment history belong to you.

appel.sous: Start your trial, prepare your mini-site and calendar, then share your link after approval.

clients.titre: Client to client — in your salon
clients.intro: A client recommends your salon. When the person they referred makes their first confirmed booking, they get a discount on their next booking with you. You fund this discount.
clients.details: One reward per booking, combinable with promotions. Calculated after promotions on the service and its options. The cap is a maximum amount per booking. Conditions already granted are kept. Any earlier booking, even cancelled, excludes the referred client. The reward stays earned after confirmation; if the referrer cancels their booking, their discount is restored until it expires.
